messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Router blackholing observed for dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-reserved' - fallback routing misfire detected. Pagerduty: PD-4242. Auto-pager to oncall-alice.
oncall-alice: I'm on it. Seeing a spike in 502s and a drop in successful routing out of the dedicated pool.
sre-jon: Linking traces - looks like router saw pool_capacity_signal=0 for that pool while the pool reported healthy nodes. Possible metric proxy problem between exporter -> router.
infra-kevin: Confirmed in cluster: node count steady at 38 GPUs, but the aggregator shows capacity=0 for ~45s around 1930023300.
oncall-alice: Impact: a subset of customer traffic (pin: enterprise-dedicated) got routed to fallback variants and then dropped when fallback policy tried to open and found no healthy candidate -> effective blackholing. Customer support already flagged a handful of errors.
product-sam: Any visible customer-facing anomalies? latency or just failures?
infra-kevin: Failures (5xx) and timeouts for long-tail streaming requests. Not huge QPS but affects high-SLA customers.
sre-jon: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) disable auto-fallback routing policy for that pool so router doesn't attempt variant swaps 2) force-router to prefer regional replicas 3) manual scale-up. Recommend 1 + 3 asap.
oncall-alice: Doing mitigation 1 now. `curl -XPOST https://router-admin/internal/policy/disable -d '{"pool":"eu-west-2-reserved","policy":"fallback"}'` -> 200 OK.
devex-liz: Noted. That should stop new misroutes. Can we also bump a manual capacity override while we investigate metrics?
infra-kevin: Applying manual capacity override to router: `routerctl set-pool-capacity eu-west-2-reserved 40 --source=manual-oncall`
pagerduty-bot: Action taken by oncall-alice: fallback-policy disabled. Pagerduty note updated.
sre-jon: Router logs snippet around the glitch: ```[1930023305] router: route_request pool=eu-west-2-reserved capacity_signal=0 variant_choice=quantized-v2 -> fallback route_score=-inf``` The variant_choice is odd — quantized-v2 isn't in the normal preferred list for that customer.
infra-kevin: That suggests the router read a stale model-variant mapping or a cached kernel selection mismatch. There was a deploy of model-variants-service at 1930023200 but deployment checks passed.
oncall-alice: Rolling back that small deploy to be safe. `kubectl -n models rollout undo deploy/variant-service --to-revision=42`
product-sam: How long until rollback stabilizes? Customers need ETA to support.
infra-kevin: Rollback started, pods terminating -> new pods ready in ~25s. Expect stable routing within ~2m after readiness.
devex-liz: Notifying CS. Drafting message: "We're mitigating routing issue affecting some dedicated customers; fallback policy temporarily disabled; next update in 30m or on resolution"
sre-jon: Root cause hypothesis: metric proxy (capacity-proxy) intermittently emitted zero for capacity when it couldn't reach the pool exporter; router treats missing as zero. Need a circuit-breaker: treat missing signal as 'unknown' not zero.
oncall-alice: Agree - create immediate mitigations now and track follow-ups. For now: fallback-policy disabled, manual capacity override applied, variant-service rolled back. Monitoring shows drop in 502s.
pagerduty-bot: Incident reassigned to infra-kevin for next 2h for in-depth investigation.
infra-kevin: I'll dig into the metric-proxy logs and exporter connectivity. If we confirm proxy bug, will put a hotfix to map 'no-signal' -> last-known or 'unknown' instead of 0.
product-sam: Any customer impact summary for postmortem?
oncall-alice: Affected: 3 enterprise customers, ~2.4k failed requests across 12 minutes. No data exfiltration. Severity SEV2.
devex-liz: Adding follow-ups to backlog: (1) metric-proxy failing-open behaviour (2) router treat-missing-as-unknown change (3) add canary check for variant-service deploys that validates mapping integrity.
sre-jon: I'll collect logs and make a short timeline for the postmortem. Can you take a handoff @infra-kevin? I'm stepping off.
infra-kevin: Taking handoff. I'll update thread with RCA and timeline.
oncall-alice: Thanks team. Handoff note: next oncall infra-kevin, PD notes updated. Will keep channel open until RCA + mitigation PR merged. :thumbsup:
